title: Stratified finite coefficient models for the all-continuous algebraic closure
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with the topology of the extended $\ell$-adic absolute value, and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, $p\ne\ell$. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Put $B(S)=C(S,\Omega)$ on profinite sets, with all continuous maps, and $A_E(S)=C(S,E)$ for a finite intermediate extension $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Omega$ with its restricted norm topology [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Put $B_T=p_T^*B$ and $A_{E,T}=p_T^*A_E$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. The continuous inclusion $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$ gives the coefficient map $A_{E,T}\to B_T$ by postcomposition and pullback [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. Modules are internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For every scheme $T$ and every $B_T$-module $M$ with finite constant local models on a finite constructible stratification [sk-def-sfb-constructible, det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model], there is a finite partition $T=\coprod_{a=1}^r T_a$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification], a finite extension $E_a/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Omega$ for each $a$, and a lisse $A_{E_a,T_a}$-module $L_a$ [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module] such that
$$B_{T_a}\otimes_{A_{E_a,T_a}}L_a\ \cong\ M|_{T_a}.$$
Here tensor is ordinary extension of internal module scalars [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. The stratification may refine the given one; neither a model for $M$ over one field on all of $T$ nor finite-subextension-valued coefficient sections are required. Empty $T$, zero modules and rank zero are included.
